changeSet.createView: SELECT a.user_id, a.app_id, a.device_id, a.request_key, a.session_id, a.last_req_time, a.login_time, a.create_ts, a.version_no, a.otp, a.otp_generation_time, a.otp_status, a.otp_validation_count, a.longitude, a.latitude, a.sublocality, a.admin_area_lvl_1, a.admin_area_lvl_2, a.country, a.formatted_address, a.origination FROM tb_astp_last_login a WHERE ((a.session_id IS NOT NULL) AND (datediff('second'::character varying, date_trunc('second'::text, a.last_req_time), (date_trunc('second'::text, now()))::timestamp without time zone) < ( SELECT c.session_timeout FROM tb_asmi_security_parameters c WHERE ((a.app_id)::text = (c.app_id)::text))));

changeSet.createView: SELECT b.os, a.app_id, count(*) AS count FROM tb_astp_last_login a, tb_asmi_device_master b WHERE (((a.app_id)::text = (b.app_id)::text) AND ((a.device_id)::text = (b.device_id)::text) AND (a.session_id IS NOT NULL) AND (datediff('second'::character varying, date_trunc('second'::text, a.last_req_time), (date_trunc('second'::text, now()))::timestamp without time zone) < ( SELECT c.session_timeout FROM tb_asmi_security_parameters c WHERE ((a.app_id)::text = (c.app_id)::text)))) GROUP BY b.os, a.app_id UNION ALL SELECT a.device_id AS os, a.app_id, count(*) AS count FROM tb_astp_last_login a WHERE (((a.device_id)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['WEB'::character varying, 'SIMULATOR'::character varying])::text[])) AND (a.session_id IS NOT NULL) AND (datediff('second'::character varying, date_trunc('second'::text, a.last_req_time), (date_trunc('second'::text, now()))::timestamp without time zone) < ( SELECT c.session_timeout FROM tb_asmi_security_parameters c WHERE ((a.app_id)::text = (c.app_id)::text)))) GROUP BY a.device_id, a.app_id;
